introduction.intro: HoiNeiLhing Singsit is from Manipur, India, and is applying for a position as a Domestic Helper in Singapore. She is single, Christian, and the 6th of 7 siblings. She is a high school graduate, born and raised in Kangpokpi District, Manipur. She has experience in childcare, as she regularly helps her relatives take care of their children. She also assists her parents and is fully responsible for all household chores in her own home. Although she has not worked in another household, she is experienced in managing household duties independently, as she handles all chores in her family home. She can cook Manipur and North Indian dishes and is willing to follow recipes. She is comfortable cooking both vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals. She is open to working with any family who is willing to hire her, except for landed houses. HoiNeiLhing is seeking an opportunity to work in Singapore to earn a stable income, save for her future, and provide financial support to her parents. She is available for an interview anytime via WhatsApp video call. Her salary is $510 + $50 and 2 off days, or $500 and 4 off days. Any no-off days less than 4 have to be compensated per MOM rulings.

Priyanka Dewan is Indian helper from Darjeeling. She is single and comes from a family with two siblings. She holds a Master’s degree (M.A), indicating a good educational background and ability to learn quickly. She can communicate in English at a fair level.

She is willing to take care of elderly and is comfortable handling household pets such as dogs. She is also open to working with Indian and vegetarian families. While she does not have prior overseas or domestic work experience, she is motivated to work and gain experience.

Priyanka prefers to work in apartment settings and is not open to landed houses. She is not experienced in infant or childcare but is willing to focus on general household duties and elderly care.

introduction.publicIntro:
Niluh Emma Kusumawati is a new helper from Indonesia. She is married with 3 children and has completed high school education. She can communicate in simple English and is fluent in Bahasa Indonesia.

She has 6 years of working experience in Indonesia, serving Chinese families. She is experienced in handling general household chores, cooking, and childcare. She has taken care of young children, including a 4-year-old and a 5-year-old, and is familiar with managing daily routines for families with children.

She is capable of performing household duties independently, including cleaning, laundry, ironing, and meal preparation. She is also willing to take on additional tasks such as gardening, car washing, and simple sewing.

Niluh Emma is a mature, responsible, and hardworking helper who is willing to learn and adapt to her employer’s needs. She is currently seeking an opportunity to work overseas to support her family.

Her salary is disclosed privately thru email and WhatsApp to the employer only. Any off day in-lieu additional allowance per MOM calculation: basic salary divided by 26 days.

She has NO medical conditions stated in the official MOM 4 page bio data

Non disclaimer:
We have to the best of our ability verify that the above information given is true; nevertheless, we cannot guarantee it as the information is given by the candidates and their agents.
